subject: Action required: Confirm forecast details for Acme Q3 deployment
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena@acme-analytics.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast check — Acme Q3 deployment

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited. We need to lock numbers for our Q3 plan this week. Finance asked for a tidy record in your CRM before they’ll sign off: final amount, SKU list, next committed milestone (PO/contract signature target), and probability.

I attached the updated quote (acme_quote_v2.pdf). Can you confirm the following on your end so we can close our internal forecast?
- Final ARR amount we should expect on contract signature
- Exact SKU/tiers being purchased (we need SKU IDs for procurement)
- Target signature date (we aimed for 2026-05-15)
- Probability you will use when reporting commit

If easiest, point me to a Sheet or HubSpot record and we’ll review there.

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
Director, Strategic Ops — Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme_quote_v2.pdf (PDF, 88KB)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast check — Acme Q3 deployment

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Lauren and Laura from revenue ops to reconcile the CRM record and confirm the numbers. Our plan: we will update the HubSpot deal with SKU-level line items, final amount, and set a commit probability. Laura will push the export back to you when done.

Lauren / Laura — action items: please do the following by EOD tomorrow (2026-04-21):
1) Verify the final ARR in HubSpot matches acme_quote_v2.pdf (expected: USD 325,000).
2) Populate SKU IDs and quantities under line items (Acme requires SKU IDs for procurement).
3) Set next step to "Contract signature" with target date 2026-05-15 and probability = 85% (proposed).
4) Export a pipeline CSV and drop in the thread (pipeline_export.csv) and add short change log.

Elena — once we update, I’ll confirm and we can sync briefly if you want to move the date.

—Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast check — Acme Q3 deployment

Quick update — I pulled the deal from HubSpot and compared to Elena's PDF. Found two discrepancies:
- HubSpot amount was USD 320,000 (missing a service add-on from quote)
- Line items listed "Enterprise Core" but missing the Professional Analytics SKU (SKU: RDW-PA-203)

Plan to fix:
- I will add RDW-PA-203 x1 (USD 5,000 ARR) to line items and update total to USD 325,000.
- Set next step = Contract signature, close date = 2026-05-15, probability = 85%.
- Export CSV and attach; include a tiny crm_changes_log.txt noting what changed.

Filing it now — attaching export. Ben, please double-check amounts and mark "Commit" in the forecast if you agree.

Laura
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Attachments: pipeline_export.csv (CSV, 3KB), crm_changes_log.txt (TXT, 512B)

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Elena Vargas <elena@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Forecast check — Acme Q3 deployment

Thanks — I reviewed the export and Laura's notes. Confirming I updated our forecast to reflect USD 325,000 ARR, added SKU RDW-PA-203, and set probability to 85%. I also set the deal stage to "Contract — Signature" in HubSpot.

Notes for the finance/forecast:
- ARR booked on signature (not pro-rated).
- No discount beyond what’s in the attached quote.
- Close trigger: signed PO or executed MSA.

Elena — you should see the HubSpot record update now: https://hubspot.example/deal/ACME-5782. Let me know if you need a one-page confirmation for procurement.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: pipeline_export.csv (CSV, 3KB)
